description: Run a Python script in a fresh virtualenv or a given external interpreter, through Dagster Pipes -- the Airflow @task.virtualenv / @task.external_python equivalent.

outputs.description: Whatever the script reports via the Pipes context (report_asset_materialization).

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key emitted by this component. The script may also report additional asset materializations via the Pipes context.

script_path.label: Script Path
script_path.description: Path (relative to the Dagster process working directory) to the Python script to run. Must call dagster_pipes.open_dagster_pipes() itself.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: 'virtualenv': build/reuse a fresh venv from requirements. 'external_python': run against an existing interpreter at python_executable, no venv created.

python_executable.label: Python Executable
python_executable.description: mode='external_python' only (required then): path to an existing Python interpreter to run the script with.

venv_path.label: Venv Path
venv_path.description: mode='virtualenv' only: where to build/cache the venv. Defaults to './.pipes_venvs/{asset_name}'.

requirements.label: Requirements
requirements.description: mode='virtualenv' only: pip package specs to install into the venv, alongside dagster-pipes (always installed).

reuse_venv.label: Reuse Venv
reuse_venv.description: mode='virtualenv' only: reuse the existing venv at venv_path if its installed requirements already match (tracked via a hash file). False always rebuilds.

args.label: Args
args.description: Extra command-line arguments appended after the script path.

env_vars.label: Env Vars
env_vars.description: Additional env vars for the script's process (merged with the parent process's own environment).

extras.label: Extras
extras.description: Arbitrary extra data passed through to the script via the Pipes context (PipesSubprocessClient.run(extras=...)).

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

name: PipesPythonAsset
